title: use_pyatb head/wing still costs the full k mesh - the '35 -> 512' step only refills occupations
symptom: Under use_pyatb the user expected the symmetry-reduced head/wing path (35 k), but head/wing is still computed over the complete 512 k set even though symmetry information is available ('对称性headwing还是用全部的k去算...为什么要展开？').
root_cause: In the use_pyatb path the driver reads pyatb_librpa_df/band_out, KS_eigenvector_*, velocity_matrix and k_path_info (driver/driver_utils.cpp:343); with use_metal_drude_head it only calls overwrite_pyatb_occupations_from_meanfield once (driver_utils.cpp:364), i.e. the 35 -> 512 step restores occupations and does NOT symmetrize head/wing. df_headwing.set(pyatb_meanfield, kfrac_band, ...) still receives the full kfrac_band from k_path_info (driver_utils.cpp:368), and in dielecmodel.cpp nk = kfrac_band.size() (:108) with both the interband head (:160) and Drude head (:208) looping over every ik.
minimal_fix: Treat use_pyatb head/wing as a full-k calculation: do not expect the 35 -> 512 occupation expansion to reduce head/wing cost. If symmetry reduction is really needed it must be implemented in dielecmodel (IBZ k plus weights) rather than assumed from the occupation fix-up; otherwise reduce the k mesh for the head/wing stage.
validation: Confirm in the run that dielecmodel loops over nk = kfrac_band.size() = 512 (dielecmodel.cpp:108/160/208) and that df_headwing.set is called with the full kfrac_band (driver_utils.cpp:368); head/wing timing should scale with the full mesh, not with the 35-point set.
avoid: Do not read the '35 -> 512' line as symmetry being applied to head/wing, and do not report a symmetry speedup for this path.

parameters.use_pyatb: reads pyatb_librpa_df (band_out, KS_eigenvector_*, velocity_matrix, k_path_info); head/wing nk = kfrac_band.size() = full k
parameters.use_metal_drude_head: only overwrites occupations; does not reduce the head/wing k sum
